name: Carrot Ginger Soup
ingredients: 1 cup cooked white beans (cannellini or navy)
100 g silken tofu, to blend in
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and splutter the cumin seeds. Add onion and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Add ginger and carrots and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the stock, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the carrots are very tender.
Add the white beans, then blend until silky smooth.
Blend the silken tofu in with the beans for extra protein and a creamier texture.
Reheat, stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper.
note: The blended white beans add protein and a creamy body without dairy.
